# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to resume the intraday trend after pulling back to VWAP when the EMA ribbon is aligned bullishly and volume confirms. This captures the mean-reversion-to-trend continuation edge observed in low-volatility morning sessions, where institutional algo activity often defends VWAP as a fair value reference before trend resumption.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On 5-minute chart, when close crosses above VWAP from below, EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon alignment), 5-minute volume > 20-period average volume, and most recent swing point is a higher low (HL). Enter long at next bar open.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at prior swing low (HL low) or 0.5% below entry, whichever is closer. Take profit at 1.5R or trail with 15% chandelier exit from highest high since entry. Only active between 09:45-12:00 EST when VIX < 20.
